name: io.theqrcode/qr-code-generator
description: Generate QR codes for URLs, WiFi, contacts and text. Paid API key adds saved codes + analytics.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer <api key>. Without it the session is anonymous and exposes only generate_qr_code (url, wifi, contact, text; 100 req/hr per IP). A Developer-plan key additionally exposes list_qr_codes and get_analytics, saves codes to the account, and enables the email QR type.
